notes.selection: Mean validation macro F1, then accuracy; no test-based selection or parameter grid.
notes.cv_std: Sample standard deviation across five fold scores (ddof=1), not a confidence interval.
notes.final_std: Not estimated for full-training/test: one full-data fit and one fixed test set.
notes.test_history: This benchmark was inspected in earlier experiments; it is not a new untouched test set.
notes.brier: Mean sum of squared class-probability errors; multiclass scale [0,2].
